gameDescriptionHtml:
All-Star Nickelodeon Characters
Pick your star-player from 15 iconic Nickelodeon characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, Avatar: The Last Airbender, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and more!

Play it your Style
Choose from over 500 outfits and accessories to customize your Nickelodeon character your way, showing off your personality on the tennis court. Turn the tide of the match with powerful ultimate abilities, unique to every character!

Play Solo or Local 1v1
Challenge a friend or family member to a 1v1 couch co-op split-screen tennis match or play the story mode at your own speed!

Instant Fun for Everyone
You don’t need to be a pro to have fun! Start playing instantly with easy-to-learn controls, accessible for the entire family.

Multiple Ways to Play
From classic matches to fun mini-games, there’s something for everyone. Embark on a narrated Story Mode, dive into Mini Games for extra fun, or rise to the top in the Tournament Mode to claim your victory!
